🎬 Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood (2019)

🎬 Movie
⭐️ Genre: Comedy, Drama
🎭 Starring: Leonardo DiCaprio, Brad Pitt, Margot Robbie

📝 Summary:
Once Upon a Time… in Hollywood follows fading television actor Rick Dalton and his longtime stunt double, Cliff Booth, as they struggle to find their place in Hollywood during the rapidly changing film industry of 1969. As Rick tries to revive his career, Cliff becomes connected to the mysterious world surrounding the Manson Family, leading their lives toward an unexpected night of violence and chaos.

🔥 Why Watch?

* Brilliant performances by DiCaprio and Brad Pitt
* Quentin Tarantino’s unique storytelling
* Stylish recreation of 1960s Hollywood
* Dark humor mixed with drama and action
* Memorable characters and unforgettable moments

🏆 Rating: 7.6/10 (IMDb)
